_scope: Family-level hints for translating GOV.UK components to the USWDS registry (github.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components). The MCP translate_component tool prefers tile classMapping, then these maps. structural entries are advisory only.

mismatches: USWDS has no start-button equivalent
USWDS disabled uses disabled='disabled' without the --disabled class
button.notes: Same <button> semantics; sentence case in both

mismatches: GOV.UK wraps label+hint+error in govuk-form-group; USWDS uses bare label+input with usa-form-group conventions
GOV.UK hint is a sibling div; USWDS uses usa-hint span
GOV.UK uses fieldset/legend + govuk-checkboxes__item wrappers; USWDS uses simpler label/input pairs — DOM restructure required
Same wrapper-pattern difference as checkboxes
GOV.UK is deliberately three fields with no calendar; USWDS offers a JS calendar (date-picker) and a memorable-date equivalent — use memorable-date to preserve the no-calendar UX
date-input.notes: Choose usa-memorable-date to keep behaviour identical

mismatches: GOV.UK banner carries its own title header; USWDS alert has heading inside the body
USWDS has site-alert for government-wide banners
Native <details> has no USWDS single-item equivalent; nearest is one-section usa-accordion
details.notes: Keep native details semantics where possible

mismatches: USWDS tables use scrollable wrapper for wide data
DOM differs: GOV.UK uses ol>li, USWDS uses ol>li too but different classes
USWDS tags are smaller; GOV.UK colour variants map to USWDS background utilities
USWDS has no summary-list; approximate with usa-description-list or a definition list with custom classes
summary-list.notes: Preserve dl semantics and visually-hidden change-link context

mismatches: USWDS process-list has no per-step collapse — weaker than app-step-nav show/hide
progress circles map, completion check maps to usa-process-list styling
step-by-step-navigation.notes: Verified in the cross-registry field test (govuk-step-by-step--uswds artifact)

mismatches: fr-stepper carries the progress bar app-step-nav lacks; per-step disclosure moves to fr-accordion
step-by-step-navigation.notes: Strongest step-navigation mapping in the registry family — verified in the field test (govuk-step-by-step--dsfr artifact)

mismatches: DSFR handles errors per field (fr-error-text + fr-*-group--error) with no page-level summary — do not port the summary; distribute errors to fields
GOV.UK banner has a header bar; DSFR alert title is inline
DSFR uses section>h3>button+collapse; GOV.UK uses h2>button+region — restructure with aria-expanded/aria-controls
